title: SOC2 daily scratchpad — evidence & vendor quicklist
content:
2026-04-12 — quick morning log (no rocket formatting, just me)

Top-of-day priorities:
- [ ] Finalize snapshot list for CC6.1 (access reviews) — need last quarter's export from Okta.
- [ ] Vendor contract checks: VaultOps + DataPipe (SLA proof + DPA signed).
- [ ] Draft short policy updates for incident-retention windows (for legal review).

Notes / scratch bits:
- Okta export: tried running user export last night, partial CSV (500 rows) dropped. Follow-up: rerun with pagination param. Command to run if needed: `okta-cli export-users --page 1 --per-page 200`
- Evidence mapping I started: CC6.1 -> `okta-access-review-2026Q1.zip` (still missing reviewer sign-off scan).
- CC4.2 (change control) — need PR list from infra repo with tags: `change:production` between 2026-01-01 and 2026-03-31. Ask SRE to attach PR hashes to evidence bundle.

Vendor review checklist (fast template for each vendor) — fill during meetings:
- Formal name + legal entity
- DPA signed? (yes/no) + attach PDF
- Where is customer data stored? (region + persistence)
- Access model (API keys / service accounts / human access)
- SOC2 / ISO certs? copy of attestation or control mapping
- SLA terms + RTO / RPO if provided
- Recent security incidents disclosed? (if yes, summary)
- Contact for escalation (name, email, phone)
- Next review date / renewal window

Items to action (short):
1) DataPipe: collect DPA + ask for current encryption-at-rest cert (owner: Maya) — ETA today EOD.
2) VaultOps: confirm key rotation logs (owner: me) — look at KMS audit trail (gcloud/kms or HSM vendor portal).
3) Evidence ingestion: create folder `evidence/CC6.1/okta/` and upload signed review scan + README.
4) Incident retention policy: add language "store for 5 years" OR "store for 7 years depending on legal; confirm with legal" — ping legal (Diego) for preference.

Meeting notes snippet (10:30 sync with infra):
- Agreed to attach PR metadata automatically on merges going forward. Action for release-eng: add small CI step to append `evidence-manifest.json` to release tar. Follow-up: file ticket REL-311.
- SRE asked whether historical PRs need retro manifests: my call — only keep last 12 months for evidence unless specifically requested.

Unresolved questions / blockers:
- Which retention timeframe does legal want for incident logs? (legal: Diego)
- Can Okta provide reviewer email timestamps as part of export? If not, need manual sign-off PDF.
- VaultOps: is our KMS audit sufficient or do we need vendor attestation? (ask applied-ml infra)

Quick snippets for evidence filenames (so things stay consistent):
- okta-access-review-2026Q1-signed.pdf
- datapipe-dpa-v2025-12-signed.pdf
- vaultops-kms-rotation-log-2026-03.tar.gz

Short daily plan (times):
- 09:00–09:30: triage vendor emails + DPA copies
- 09:30–10:30: meet infra, capture PR metadata action items (done)
- 10:45–12:00: evidence ingestion + README generation for CC6.1
- 13:00–15:00: vendor calls (VaultOps 14:00, DataPipe 14:45)
- 15:30–16:00: write up policy draft for retention; send to Diego/Legal

Notes to self / reminders (messy):
- keep filenames short and consistent — no spaces, use dashes.
- when uploading to Confluence, add a single-line summary for auditors.
- keep a snapshot of the Slack thread for handoff.

If I get blocked on the Okta export: fallback is to request CSV + verbiage from identity team and attach email chain as proof.

End of scratchpad. Will tidy into a proper evidence checklist later if needed.

-- Noah
